scope.cost: prefix plus probability-weighted suffix tokens; excludes GPU and feature overhead
scope.variance: empirical pooled B gradients, conditional on surviving decision-point prefixes
scope.oracle: noisy A-fit/B-score reference; not a theoretical bound
scope.bootstrap: problem clusters, conditional on fitted predictions
scope.single_problem_fallback: cross-problem prediction unavailable; only zero predictions recorded
scope.policy: frozen original post-trained model with fresh zero-B LoRA, not old Base policy
